items.claim: Catalog-only edits turned Submit on and then submitted nothing
items.note: `PrefSchemaEditor`'s Changes tab and Submit now carry only the schema's changes. The fix adds an `AssetEditor` option, `sends(asset)`, with a minor changeset because that is new API.

items.claim: Unit suffix `mm` can't be typed past an existing `m`
items.note: A row whose name clashes with another's now shows the typed text and is marked invalid, and it is written once its name is unique.

items.claim: The identity glyph is offset from the wrong edge in right-to-left layouts
items.note: In right-to-left layouts the inset is now measured from the left edges.
